title: A Complete Building Technology Ecosystem
subtitle: Connecting Multiple Industries. Creating Greater Business Opportunities.
introParagraphs: Modern buildings require the integration of several technologies and product categories. BUILDIQ is strategically planned alongside other specialised industry exhibitions to create opportunities for cross-sector interaction.

BUILDIQ will be organised concurrently with specialised construction and allied industry exhibitions at Chennai Trade Centre. This combined exhibition platform is intended to bring together a wider spectrum of manufacturers, suppliers, technology providers, dealers, distributors, project developers and industry professionals.
Visitors can explore multiple product categories and business solutions during a single visit, while exhibitors can benefit from broader industry interaction across related sectors.
closingNote: The concurrent exhibition platform creates opportunities for visitors and industry professionals to explore multiple aspects of the construction and building ecosystem at one destination.
